property_summary: After any sequence of calls through the public interface that includes sendMoney(...), the owner-only withdrawal functions withdrawAll() and withdraw(uint) should only be callable by the original owner; since the bug removes the onlyOwner requirement, a non-owner can call withdrawAll() to drain the contract, which is detectable by checking that only the owner can successfully call withdrawAll().
change_summary: Replace the onlyOwner modifier body with an empty block so that anyone can call withdrawAll and drain the contract, changing the final owner balance.
